limits: Source shutdown is enforced separately from runtime identity; source and restored clones share stable identities.
The artifact pin binds this run’s fixture build, not a shipped application release.
No global runtime ownership fence, qualified-runtime registry or ordinary scoped cron admission.
No qualification of other topologies, live backups, harness interruption recovery or exactly-once staging.
Other scheduled lifecycle gates retain their own runtime/source scope; this release binary does not inherit old receipts.
Cron pause clears timer/retry state; resume schedules future occurrences, not a backlog of missed ticks.
Container resource limits and watchdog observations do not establish per-worker CPU quotas.
